code.description: Six-digit synthetic example. Real codes are delivered out of band.

newPassword.description: Required only for password_recovery; accepted as a passphrase and stored only as an Argon2id hash.

provisioningUri.description: Contains the authenticator secret. Shown only in the start response and never returned by status or retries.

code.description: Six-digit TOTP from the authenticator app. Synthetic example only.

recoveryCodes.description: One-time recovery codes. Save them now; the API stores only SHA-256 digests and never returns them again.

code.description: Six-digit TOTP or one 26-character recovery code. Synthetic example only.
